description: Custom Recipe — In-game Fabric recipe manager for Minecraft 1.20.1 to 26.2; 26.3 is coming soon.

mods.name: Custom Recipe
mods.description: Create and manage shaped or shapeless recipes in game. Includes built-ins, vanilla recipe controls, material variants, and OP server configuration.

releases.notes:
## Recipes Creator 1.2.1

### Recipe management overhaul

- Added **Known by default**, missing-mod recovery, exact recipe-conflict handling, and material-variant controls.
- Reworked **Default Recipes** with installed-mod recipes, live search, status filters, tag previews, and per-material variants.
- Reworked the recipe creator with reusable items, persistent item selection, protected slots, and a permanent Empty clear tile.

### Client and server support

- Kept client and server item/recipe catalogs separate so different mod lists remain safe.
- Local ModMenu recipes are staged in the OP `/customrecipe` server editor and are only published when the OP clicks **Save**.
- Staged recipes are checked against the server catalog before the editor opens for missing mods and conflicts.

### 1.20.1 fixes

- Fixed local Vanilla and installed-mod recipe discovery, legacy recipe result JSON, and tool material-tag previews.
- Preserved disabled variants, custom-output selection, Vanilla priority, and Shift-crafting in the green recipe book.
